thresholds.label: Invalid purchase dates (%)
thresholds.rationale: Trend KPIs (monthly revenue/volume) become unreliable above ~3% bad dates.
thresholds.sensitivity: Lowering to 1% increases false alerts on small samples; 5% would hide material bias.
thresholds.action_if_breach: Exclude DateInvalid from trends; fix POS date capture.

thresholds.label: Unknown product category (%)
thresholds.rationale: Category mix and revenue share mislead merchandising when Unknown exceeds one-fifth of rows.
thresholds.sensitivity: 15% is aggressive for legacy data; 25% too permissive for assortment decisions.
thresholds.action_if_breach: Mandatory category at POS; temporary mapping table for backfill.

thresholds.label: Missing purchase amount (%)
thresholds.rationale: Revenue KPIs understate performance if amounts are missing.
thresholds.sensitivity: Current value is near the threshold; small data shifts can flip OK/ALERT.

thresholds.label: Missing age after domain purge (%)
thresholds.rationale: Age-band analysis and demographic targeting need sufficient coverage.
thresholds.sensitivity: Source pollution (-1, 200) drives high missingness after purge; threshold reflects residual risk not raw nulls.

thresholds.label: Missing / invalid ratings (%)
thresholds.rationale: Experience KPIs need representative rating coverage.
thresholds.sensitivity: Out-of-scale values (e.g. 10) inflate missingness after domain filter.

thresholds.label: Duplicate CustomerIDs removed (count)
thresholds.rationale: Duplicate IDs inflate customer counts and distort per-customer metrics.
thresholds.sensitivity: Any duplicate is a process defect; threshold is count-based not percentage.

recommendations: Keep invalid_dates threshold at 3% — material for trend integrity.
Tighten unknown_category target to 15% as a stretch goal once POS controls land.
missing_amount sits near 5% — monitor weekly to avoid silent revenue undercount.
Age and rating thresholds remain medium until source widgets are constrained.
Wire the same threshold table into Airflow sensors for automated gatekeeping.
